per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The UI should warn users before saving invalid data, such as conflicts or missing prerequisites.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall have basic data integrity checking to reduce the possibility of incorrect or invalid data being introduced.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should prevent obvious mistakes, such as double-booking a clinical or enrolling a student without prerequisites.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall help the user avoid making mistakes while scheduling classes and clinicals for the nursing students.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should use familiar nursing terms and avoid jargon.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The verbiage used within the system shall be consistent with Standard English and the terminology of the national Nursing Community.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Small tasks should take a few seconds, while larger tasks should complete in under a minute.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The response time of general student management tasks shall take no longer than 5 seconds and the response time of schedule generation shall take no longer than 30 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must handle about ten people all active at once during mornings.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'system shall be able to handle all of the user requests/usage during business hours.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be available during business hours (8 AM–6 PM weekdays) with 95% overall availability.

Program Admins should have full access, Instructors should have limited access to their students' data, Site coordinators should only see necessary info, and Support staff should be able to generate reports but not modify enrollments.
Sensitive student info, such as health data and personal identifiers, must be restricted.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The system shall protect private information in accordance with the organization's information policy.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should allow versioning and editing of curriculum structures, which change every 1–2 years.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall be expected to manage the nursing program curriculum and class/clinical scheduling for a minimum of 5 years.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should prevent bad data via picklists, smart matching, and CSV import checks.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall have basic data integrity checking to reduce the possibility of incorrect or invalid data being introduced.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Program Admins should be able to fix day-to-day issues without IT involvement.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall be easy to use by the Program Administrators/Nursing Staff Members.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must integrate with CampusConnect for real-time or near-real-time sync of student rosters to avoid duplicates.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The system shall interface with CampusConnect's central server'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must export clean CSV/Excel files with historical data for audits.
